sloka: पिता पितामहस्तस्य तथैव प्रपितामहः ।तत्पिता तत्पिता चैव विष्णुं यान्ति न संशयः ।। ७.१११.२२ ॥
transliteration: pitā pitāmahastasya tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।tatpitā tatpitā caiva viṣṇuṁ yānti na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.111.22 ॥

translations.english: His father, grandfather, and similarly his great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, and great-great-great-grandfather all certainly go to Vishnu; there is no doubt about it.
translations.hindi: अब उस काव्य को सुनने के लिए उत्सुक हो कर, श्रोरामचन्द्र जीने उनसे पूछा
